description: The α_EM loop-measure 1/π weight (1/(8π)=1/(2π·g)) from the spectral-zeta side. data.verdict: The loop-measure 1/π weight is NOT forced by standard spectral-zeta invariants. Every standard 2D spectral invariant is Euler-characteristic-linear (a₁=χ/6, ζ_Δ(0)=χ/6−1) or extensive (a₀·Area, μ-dependent). The PROVED 2/(3π) Bloch–Wigner term IS such an Euler quantity (b₁/Area, Area=−2πχ=12π). But the OPEN loop measure 1/(8π)=1/(2π·g) needs a GENUS-linear (∝g) source, and χ=2−2g is not ∝ g — so no standard invariant forces it (the precise obstruction). The ½·a₀ chiral decomposition (½=H^{1,0}/H¹, a₀=1/(4π)) numerically hits 1/(8π) but is g-INDEPENDENT, giving 1/(8π) for every surface — it cannot select Bring, so the g=4 match is a coincidence, not the mechanism. CONCLUSION: the 1/π loop weight stays genuinely open; a genuine derivation needs a genus-linear spectral quantity (Ray–Singer/Quillen with an odd zero-mode structure, or the archimedean dilog regulator) that standard heat-kernel geometry does not supply. Converges with alpha_em_permode_weight_probe and the τ=W adversarial audit. No fit; no instance; 1/(8π) phase-4; nothing wired.

caveats: The 2/(3π) Bloch–Wigner term is Euler-characteristic (proved). The 1/(8π) loop measure needs a GENUS-linear source, distinct from every standard heat-kernel/ζ invariant (all χ-linear). The ½·a₀ chiral decomposition is g-independent, so it cannot be the Bring-specific mechanism — the g=4 match is coincidental.
